synthesis: Oscar (via Eric) reported that on a historical date range the Scout map rendered closed/repossessed hit logo markers, while the left 'Live Hits Pending Repossession' pane showed only open hits. ROOT CAUSE (confirmed via read-only live ClickHouse reproduction): clarity.hits_hot.hotlist_status is a per-row snapshot frozen at hit-write time and NEVER back-updated when the order is later repossessed/closed (30d: 17% of plate-keys carry >1 distinct status across rows). The marker endpoint (ClarityScoutMapController@hits) includes Staging Live ('S') rows, which are almost always stamped Open (16,021 open vs 1,302 closed) and rarely re-scanned to ever get a closing row, does NO plate dedup, and filters hotlist_status=1 at the raw-row level -> so a plate repossessed long ago still has a stale-Open Staging row that passes the filter and gets pinned. The leak is 91% Staging (216/218 problem plate-keys are Staging; only 7 Direct). The left pane and heatmap escape this only because they are Direct-only (where closed rows dominate) + the pane plate-dedupes. FIX (human-approved): filter historical markers by the order's CURRENT status from clarity.hotlist (CDC-synced, FINAL) via a semi-join on hits_hot.hotlist_id -> clarity.hotlist.id, replacing the frozen per-row hotlist_status filter. Correct for both Direct and Staging; preserves Staging markers (DEV-2052); keeps per-hit marker granularity; aligns with DEV-2080's canonical-status direction.

scope.summary: Filter the historical map markers by the order's CURRENT hotlist status (clarity.hotlist.status = Open, via clarity.hotlist FINAL keyed on hits_hot.hotlist_id) instead of the frozen per-row hits.hotlist_status. Replace the `->where('hotlist_status', Open)` filter in ClarityScoutMapController@hits with a current-status semi-join, applied BEFORE the limit so the cap counts only currently-open hits. Keep validDisposition() (per-hit, correct). Keep per-hit marker granularity (no plate dedup). Update existing tests to seed clarity.hotlist rows (current status now governs, not the hit row's status) and add Staging + Direct stale-status regression cases.

proposed_changes.change: In hits(): replace ->where('hotlist_status', HotlistStatusEnum::Open->value) with a current-status filter sourced from clarity.hotlist. Recommended efficient shape: (1) collect candidate hotlist_ids from the scoped hit set, (2) resolve which are currently Open via Hotlist (FINAL global scope) ->forStatus(Open), (3) constrain the marker query to hotlist_id IN (open set) BEFORE limit(MAX+1). Keep ->validDisposition() and the kit_org_id/kit_id/forHitTypes/forCreatedBetween scoping. The cap must apply to currently-open hits only.
proposed_changes.reason: The frozen per-row hotlist_status lets stale-Open Staging rows through (and could wrongly drop a currently-open plate whose row is stale-closed). clarity.hotlist.status is the CDC-synced current truth.

proposed_changes.change: Update existing marker tests to seed clarity.hotlist rows (matching hotlist_id) since current hotlist status now governs inclusion, not the hit row's denormalized status. Add regression cases: (a) Staging Live ('S') hit with stale-Open hit-row status but clarity.hotlist.status=Repossessed -> EXCLUDED; (b) Staging Live with hotlist Open -> INCLUDED; (c) Direct equivalent of (a) -> EXCLUDED. Carry #[Group('controllers')] #[Group('clarity-scout')].
proposed_changes.reason: Pins the new current-status semantics for both clusters; the existing test_map_hits_only_returns_open_status_hits relied solely on the hit-row status and must be updated to seed the hotlist.
